usage.finalMessage:
I added the `owes <member>` command and made borrowing fail for anyone owing more than 5.00; staff are exempt. All 22 tests pass, and the work and the report are committed.
R3 is only partly done. Staff can still be refused when someone else is first in a book's hold queue (DEC-005) or when they're suspended (L01). Removing those refusals would contradict an accepted decision, so that needs a revision by the decision's owner.
The report lists this as an open question.

OUTCOME: completed
